text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down 1.6% over 24 hours, signaling mild profit-taking despite elevated sentiment. The Fear & Greed index sits at 74 (Greed) and climbing, while Bitcoin dominance holds steady above 59%, suggesting investors remain confident in the major assets even as altcoins soften. Volume at $112B is moderate for the current price level, indicating the market is consolidating rather than capitulating.
